controles.affirmation: Le 31 juillet 2026, APS a demande a l'ACC de relever son plafond statutaire de dette long terme de 9,5 a 12 Mds $ ; APS ne peut predire l'issue
controles.verbatim_source: On July 31, 2026, APS submitted an application to the ACC requesting to increase the long-term debt limit from $9.5 billion to $12 billion. APS cannot predict the outcome of this matter. (10-Q 2026-08-04)

controles.affirmation: APS a depose le 13 juin 2025 une demande de hausse nette des tarifs de base de 579,5 M$ (+13,99%)
controles.verbatim_source: On June 13, 2025, APS filed an application with the ACC (the 2025 Rate Case) seeking a net base rate increase of $579.5 million, which represents a 13.99% net increase.
controles.correction_proposee: Precision utile : en rejoinder du 11 mai 2026 APS a ramene la demande nette a 608,7 M$ (total 691,6 M$), le chiffre de 579,5 M$ n'est plus la demande courante.

controles.affirmation: L'audience a demarre en mai 2026
controles.verbatim_source: On May 11, 2026, APS filed its rejoinder testimony ... The hearing concluded on July 7, 2026.
controles.correction_proposee: L'audience s'est CLOTUREE le 7 juillet 2026 ; mai 2026 correspond aux surrebuttal (1er mai) et rejoinder (11 mai) testimonies, pas au debut de l'audience.

controles.affirmation: Une decision est attendue avant la fin de l'annee
controles.verbatim_source: The order noted that the case is anticipated to be resolved before the end of this year.

controles.affirmation: APS declare ne pas pouvoir predire l'issue ni la date de la decision
controles.verbatim_source: APS cannot predict the outcome of its request nor when the 2025 Rate Case will be decided by the ACC.

controles.affirmation: Le 11 juillet 2025, APS a ete nommee avec les 25 autres exploitants nucleaires americains dans un recours collectif devant le tribunal federal du Maryland, allegant une entente sur l'echange d'informations de remuneration
controles.verbatim_source: On July 11, 2025, APS, together with all 25 other U.S. nuclear power plant operators, was named in a class action lawsuit brought in the U.S. District Court in Maryland. The lawsuit alleges the country's nuclear operators have violated antitrust laws by agreeing to exchange compensation information and suppress compensation.

controles.affirmation: La societe pourrait devoir deposer jusqu'a 711 M$ de collateral supplementaire sur ses contrats DERIVES d'energie en cas de perte de l'investment grade
controles.verbatim_source: we also have energy related non-derivative instrument contracts, with investment grade credit-related contingent features, which could also require us to post additional collateral of approximately $711 million if our debt credit ratings were to fall below investment grade.
controles.correction_proposee: Il s'agit de contrats energetiques NON derives (non-derivative instrument contracts). Ecrire : 'sur ses contrats energetiques non derives'.

controles.affirmation: Les pipelines gaz existants vers l'Arizona sont 100% committed ; accord de transport signe juillet 2025 ; nouveau pipeline operationnel fin 2029 ; jusqu'a 2 000 MW de gaz flexible prevus
controles.verbatim_source: existing natural gas pipelines into Arizona are currently 100% committed. As a result, in July 2025, APS executed a gas transportation precedent agreement to secure a long-term supply of natural gas. The new pipeline is expected to be operational by late 2029 ... APS also plans to add up to 2,000 MW of flexible natural gas generation (10-K FY2025)

controles.affirmation: Loi Arizona signee en mai 2025 imposant des plans de mitigation incendie ; facteur de risque 'shortfalls in insurance coverage'
controles.verbatim_source: on May 12, 2025, Arizona Governor Hobbs signed into law a bill that requires Arizona electric utilities to develop and seek approval for wildfire mitigation plans ... potential shortfalls in insurance coverage

controles.affirmation: Au T2 2026, la croissance du nombre de clients detail n'est que de 2,2%
controles.verbatim_source: Retail customers in APS's service territory increased 2.1% for the period ended June 30, 2026 compared with the prior-year period. For the three years through 2025, APS's customer growth averaged 2.2% per year.
controles.correction_proposee: 2,1% pour la periode close au 30 juin 2026. Le 2,2% est la moyenne annuelle sur les trois annees jusqu'en 2025 : deux mesures differentes confondues.

controles.affirmation: Croissance des ventes normalisees de la meteo de 9,4% au T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Retail electricity sales in kWh, adjusted to exclude the effects of weather variations, increased ... 9.5% for all retail customers for the period ended June 30, 2026
controles.correction_proposee: 9,5%, pas 9,4%. Le chiffre 9,4% n'apparait nulle part dans le 10-Q.

controles.affirmation: Seuls 4,5 GW de charge incrementale sont engages (committed) contre une file d'attente non engagee de 20 GW ; source citee kpis-haut PNW committed_incremental_customer_load / uncommitted_large_customer_demand_queue
controles.verbatim_source: Aucune occurrence de '4.5 GW', '20 GW', '4,500 MW' ni '20,000 MW' dans le 10-Q T2 2026. Les cles KPI citees n'existent pas dans .batches-drafts-safe/kpis-haut/PNW.json (qui ne contient ni committed_incremental_customer_load ni uncommitted_large_customer_demand_queue) ; elles n'existent nulle part ailleurs dans src/data ni .batches-drafts-safe.
controles.correction_proposee: Supprimer l'affirmation et la preuve. Element factuel disponible a la place : 'we currently project that annual retail electricity sales in kWh will increase' + contribution data centers 3,0% a 5,0% en 2026 (10-Q).

controles.affirmation: Les cles KPI citees retail_customer_growth et weather_normalized_retail_sales_growth
controles.verbatim_source: kpis-haut/PNW.json contient customer_growth (2,1%) et retail_sales_growth_guidance ; aucune cle nommee retail_customer_growth ni weather_normalized_retail_sales_growth.
controles.correction_proposee: Citer les cles reelles ou directement le 10-Q.

controles.affirmation: Dette long terme 9,78 Mds $ au T2 2026, +14,9% sur un an ; fonds propres 7,03 Mds $, +4,6%
controles.verbatim_source: LONG-TERM DEBT LESS CURRENT MATURITIES 9,775,808 (30/06/2026) vs 8,507,002 (30/06/2025, 10-Q 2025-08-06) = +14,9% ; Total shareholders' equity 7,034,754 vs 6,726,788 = +4,6%

controles.affirmation: Sur la meme periode, le chiffre d'affaires progresse de +4,2%
controles.correction_proposee: +7,1% sur le trimestre (ou +9,0% sur six mois). Le +4,2% ne correspond a aucune ligne du 10-Q.

controles.affirmation: Hausse des charges d'interets : 223,6 M$ sur six mois 2026 contre 189,0 M$ un an plus tot
controles.verbatim_source: Interest, net of amounts capitalized 223,625 / 189,041 (supplemental cash flow : interets PAYES en tresorerie). Ligne compte de resultat : INTEREST EXPENSE Interest charges 259,360 (6M 2026) vs 218,470 (6M 2025), total net AFUDC 238,095 vs 196,809.
controles.correction_proposee: Charges d'interets six mois 2026 : 259,4 M$ contre 218,5 M$ (ou 238,1 M$ contre 196,8 M$ apres AFUDC emprunts). Les 223,6/189,0 M$ sont des interets payes en tresorerie, pas des charges.
